artworks.title: Pines
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a natural scene with a rocky terrain and trees viewed from a slightly elevated angle. A large rock formation is centered in the drawing, surrounded by tall, slender trees. The sky above includes soft clouds, all rendered in a monochromatic color palette of gray, black, and beige.

artworks.title: Bellosguardo, Florence
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The drawing shows a landscape with terraced fields, trees, shrubs, and hills. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, allowing for a clear view. The horizon is high in the picture. The pencil strokes are soft, creating a detailed texture. The color palette is monochromatic with black, gray, and beige tones.

artworks.title: On Green River
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image is an oval-shaped, black-and-white sketch of a landscape viewed from a side perspective. A tree is on the left, with branches covered in leaves. A body of water reflects the scene. Hills with trees are in the distance. The technique uses shading and line work to create texture and depth, emphasizing the tranquil mood. The color palette is monochrome, focusing on light and shadow.

artworks.title: Trucks [recto]
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: Three vintage trucks are displayed in the image. Each truck is portrayed from the front, with early 20th-century designs featuring notable grilles and rounded headlights. The trucks are shown with coverings on their cargo areas and pencil shading is used to create depth and texture. Some parts of the drawing are more detailed than others, emphasizing specific features such as the grilles and shadows from the tarps.

artworks.title: Bust of a Man
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a man shown from the shoulders up. He is positioned facing forward, and his facial features are detailed with a prominent nose and expressive eyes. The man has short, receding hair. His clothing appears to be a suit with a jacket and a glimpse of a shirt or vest. The background of the drawing is plain, consisting solely of the sketch paper. There are no visible jewelry or objects in the image.

artworks.title: The Alps [recto]
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)

artworks.title: Gun Carriages, France
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of early vehicles, including a steam engine and other machinery. The drawing is a detailed pencil sketch showcasing a steam engine type vehicle prominently on the upper left with large wheels, a funnel-shaped chimney, and complex mechanical parts. To the right and across the bottom of the image, there are additional sketches of similar machinery. Each vehicle has large spoked wheels and intricate mechanical components. The drawing demonstrates an interest in mechanical details and the structure of these early vehicles.

artworks.title: Studies of Cattle
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)

artworks.title: Seated Woman
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a woman from the knees up, in a slightly turned position. Her facial features are softly sketched with a gentle expression. Her hair is styled neatly under a large hat. She is wearing a long elegant garment with flowing lines, accentuating her figure. The garment is detailed with shading indicating texture, possibly fur or formal detail around the shoulders and upper body. The background consists of horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Men on a Spar
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)

artworks.title: Chez le tailleur chez le coiffeur
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring two scenarios - one at a tailor shop and the other at a hair salon. The top panel shows two people in the tailor shop with exaggerated, humorous interactions during a clothing fitting. The bottom panel depicts a scene in the hair salon with a comical hairdressing session. The illustrations are detailed and characterized by expressive, exaggerated characters in a satirical style. The scenes focus on humor in everyday tasks.

artworks.title: Couple on a Cot
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)

artworks.title: Mother and Child [recto]
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The sketch shows two figures. On the right, a person with short hair is holding a child. The child is facing forward with short, wavy hair. Both figures are wearing casual clothes, with the adult potentially having textured clothing. On the left, another figure is seated at a table, shown from behind with short hair. The background is minimal, with some suggested furniture lines near the table.

artworks.title: Ramparts at St. Malo—Yacht Race
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures on a balcony with a sculptural element. The drawing depicts darkly shaded silhouettes of figures gathered on a balcony or raised platform. The right side features a large cylindrical structure topped with a dome, adorned with sculptural outlines. The figures appear in various postures, some seated and others standing, with one figure looking through a telescope. The drawing uses bold, quick strokes to suggest movement and activity, while lighter scribbles add to the setting's depth and texture.

artworks.title: Seated Men
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The pencil sketch shows two individuals with full bodies, sitting close together with legs stretched out. The figures are depicted with minimal facial detail and are wearing what appears to be formal attire. One figure seems to be holding a cigarette. The background is abstract with some shading and lines, possibly suggesting an environment.

artworks.title: Studies for "The Fall of Gog and Magog"
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image depicts two dogs lying down. The dogs are resting side by side, slightly overlapping each other. The artist uses soft pencil shading to convey the muscular structure and volume of the dogs. The sketch focuses on capturing the form and posture of the animals rather than intricate details.

artworks.title: Studies for "Scots Grey"
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pair of figures engaging in a task involving a large animal. The sketch depicts two scenes side by side, both featuring a figure in a cap interacting with the large shape of an animal, likely a horse. The strokes are light and gestural, capturing the essence of movement and form with minimal detail. The drawing is executed in pencil, focusing on the contours and implied lines rather than intricate detailing. The figures are positioned with one hand tracing or holding the side of the animal. This artwork appears unfinished or a preliminary study, capturing the fluidity and dynamics of the interaction.

artworks.title: Studies for "Apollo and the Muses"
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)

artworks.title: Studies for "Dancing Figures"
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch with two partial views of a human form from behind. The first figure on the left displays the torso and arms, with the left arm raised above the head and the head turned slightly to the left. The second figure on the right extends from the upper body to the legs, with the right leg slightly behind the left. The sketch focuses on the body forms, which are nude, showing contour and shading. The background is plain and unadorned.

artworks.title: Study for "Astronomy"
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image shows a rough sketch of a person from the waist up. The person is depicted sitting or leaning back with their head slightly tilted up. The face has closed eyes or is looking slightly upward with a subtle expression. The hair is shown in simple lines, indicating it is short or slicked back. The person is wearing a sleeveless garment and one arm is crossing over the body, holding a piece of draped fabric or loose clothing around the legs. The sketch does not include any jewelry or additional objects, and the background is plain and unadorned.

artworks.title: Studies for "Two Classical Male Figures Jumping"
artworks.medium: charcoal and graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grid with overlapping forms. The description of the image reveals a large sheet with two main sections. The top section features a smaller grid containing abstract, organic lines. The lines suggest forms of figures or motion, enclosed by intersecting linear patterns. Below it, a larger grid takes up most of the page, presenting an illustration in simple linework that resembles human figures in a dynamic, forward-moving pose. The larger figure appears to be pulling or reaching toward the smaller one. The drawing overall gives an impression of planning or studying motion or form through the use of grid lines.

artworks.title: Study of a Draped Figure
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a human figure, focusing on the lower half of the body. The person is lying down, with the torso slightly twisted and bent knees. The face is not visible, and the hair cannot be seen. The person is draped in a piece of cloth that falls naturally around the body, with one foot partially visible at the lower left of the image. The sketch does not show any jewelry or objects being held. The background is a plain, light beige color.

artworks.title: Study for "Hell"
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The sketch depicts a person in a reclined position, lying on their side on an abstract surface. Their left arm is extended outward, while their head rests on the left forearm. The drawing lacks fine facial details or clear hair details, focusing on the body's form and posture. The person seems unclothed with no visible accessories. The background is a plain surface. The sketch is done in soft pencil or charcoal on neutral-toned paper, emphasizing the body's contours with fluid, gestural lines.

artworks.title: By the Fountain, Villa Torlonia, Frascati, Italy
